label: .overlapKeepsMax: overlapping dabs summed instead of keeping the larger coverage
.boundsHoldDabs: the grid's far edge one pixel short clips the outermost dab
find: (x1, y1) = (max(x1, d.originX + d.width), max(y1, d.originY + d.height))
replace: (x1, y1) = (max(x1, d.originX + d.width - 1), max(y1, d.originY + d.height - 1))
